runs.name: Hitachi Construction Machinery Co., Ltd.
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **¥5,606** (Tokyo close 2026-10-13, Yahoo Finance chart API, aggregator quote, flagged; no ADS price stated). Shares **206,761,281**, one class (215,115,038 issued per the 62nd-term Annual Securities Report and the Q1 FY2026 Kessan Tanshin, less 2,354,657 treasury at 2026-06-30, less 5,999,100 repurchased 2026-08-19 to 2026-10-08 per the company notices of 2026-09-04, 2026-10-02 and 2026-10-09); cap **¥1,159,104M**. Sovereign **4.085%** (JPY; Japan Ministry of Finance `jgbcme.csv`, 30-year JGB, row dated 2026/10/9). Not an SEC registrant (EDGAR holds Forms F-6 only); `tools/run.py` and `Screens/cover_shares.py` produced nothing; every figure read from the company's own documents. Filings read (documents and dates in place of accession numbers): the Annual Securities Reports (English translations) for the 53rd to 62nd terms (62nd filed 2026-06-23 with the Kanto Local Finance Bureau), the Q1 FY2026 Kessan Tanshin of 2026-07-30, the notices of 2026-02-19, 2026-05-25 (name change to LANDCROS Corporation from April 2027), 2026-08-19 (Hitachi, Ltd.'s sale of 21,462,310 shares, the repurchase resolution, the major-shareholder change) and the repurchase notices; the governance section not reached. One figure cross-checked: total assets ¥1,857,321M at 2026-03-31 equal in the 62nd report and the Kessan Tanshin; a misprint found in the 59th report's cash-flow table (FY2022 capital expenditure printed as ¥53,479M, the ACME guarantee payment; ¥52,839M from its own text and the 60th report used). Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the report's Description of Business, Business Risks and Management Analysis: the cycle, the competitive position, cash conversion, capital and control, the exposures. Competitors: the reports name no rival; Caterpillar, Deere and CNH read from their SEC data (tagged data, not their filings; Deere and CNH mainly agricultural, shown for completeness); Komatsu, Volvo CE, Sany, XCMG, Kobelco and Liebherr flagged as not SEC filers. **Q1 IN**: a cyclical heavy-machinery maker whose ten-year economics read from its statements; Construction Machinery 91.3% of five-year segment profit decides. **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part's castle protects only ordinary returns over a full cycle and it is not the low-cost operator: after-tax return on capital 7.5% average FY2016 to FY2025 (8.2% tangible), never above 10.3%; operating margin 8.8% against Caterpillar 13.7% over the decade, below it in eight of ten years; prices raised FY2023 to FY2025 while the margin fell 11.6% to 9.3%; the filer names "a decline in selling prices caused by intensified competition" as a risk; ROE 8.6% FY2025 against its own "over 13%". Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after every real cost ¥20,452M a year FY2021 to FY2025 (all-equity, after acquisitions), ¥9,702M over ten years, against net income to the parent ¥78,783M (the difference in inventories, receivables and the rental fleet, bought through operating cash at ¥64bn to ¥82bn a year); range **¥479 to ¥8,036 a share** all-equity (bottom all spending no growth over the literal window, the series changing sign; top the maintenance-only case with depreciation as the disclosed guess, growth spending having earned about 2.3% on some ¥272bn), net debt ¥401,718M (the repurchase cash added, a CONVENTION of the run), against ¥5,606; no case earns the floor (top 5.40%); fair **¥590** all-equity, ¥2,240 equity-only, ¥754 with filed net debt alone; no alert (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets, ten years read: inventories 33% of revenue (March 2016) to 38.5% (March 2026), ¥582.5bn at June 2026; debt ¥217.9bn to ¥497.6bn; goodwill and intangibles about six-fold; the FY2022 ¥53,479M guarantee payment for affiliate ACME, ended by taking ACME over in March 2024; guarantee obligations ¥56,564M at March 2026. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: the 2026 repurchase of 5,999,100 shares at about ¥5,667 "to mitigate" Hitachi, Ltd.'s sale, with no price limit, far above the range's bottom; the ACME episode; the featured adjusted operating income; ITOCHU about 33.4% directly and through HCJI with a standstill; a plan for about ¥500bn of growth investment with "financial leverage" and "inorganic growth"; the Deere supply contract to February 2027. Contamination declared by the analyst: a filtered listing showed the 2026-07-15 HTCMY run's file name; a misdirected download listed the repository root and showed the name `PORTFOLIO.md`; neither opened. That command wrote two of the analyst's own files into the root, deleted by it at once; three untracked PDFs in the root (`ar22.pdf`, `ar23.pdf`, `ar24.pdf`) are not this run's and were left. Commits 9d7a24f1, a371894e, f7fecb59, 2bfd8497. Citations: the analyst's check 39 ids, 33 fragments, 0 problems; the dispatcher's script (`_dispatcher_cite_check.py`) 13 quotation pairs, no slip, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) Q2's ordinary-returns item speaks of a field; here the leader earns well above ordinary and it is the part's own returns that are ordinary; applied with the high-cost item and L2007-004; (2) a repurchase completed after the latest balance sheet is not covered by the net-debt rule; (3) IFRS 16 leases; (4) non-controlling interests not addressed in Q7; (5) whether depreciation as the maintenance proxy counts as the filing allowing the guess under specific (e); (6) debt funding customers' finance receivables; (7) the fair price averages a negative end; (8) the template's accessions and proxy for a foreign filer. Could not get: a parts-and-service split, a maintenance figure, a captive-finance balance sheet, rivals' filed statements (tagged data used).
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a cyclical maker of hydraulic excavators, mining excavators and wheel loaders (to be renamed LANDCROS Corporation in April 2027; Hitachi, Ltd. sold its last 21.46M shares in August 2026) whose deciding part earns only ordinary returns over a full cycle, after-tax return on capital 7.5% FY2016 to FY2025, operating margin 8.8% against Caterpillar's 13.7%, prices raised while the margin fell, price competition named by the filer. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range ¥479 to ¥8,036 a share all-equity against ¥5,606, no case earns the floor; fair ¥590 all-equity (¥2,240 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: ¥34.0bn of buybacks at about ¥5,667 to absorb Hitachi's sale with no price limit, the ACME guarantee payment and takeover.
